lines: Thus in fifteenfold standing, as far as
the lack of distinct this-ness-difference, pair-pair
diminishes; as far as two-segment Śiva-immersion:
there first segment everywhere complete; second
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ ca pāñcadaśye sthite yāvat sphuṭedaṃtātmano bhedasya nyūnatā tāvat dvayaṃ dvayaṃ hrasati yāvat dvituṭikaḥ śivāveśaḥ tatra ādyā tuṭiḥ sarvataḥ pūrṇā dvitīyā sarvajñānakaraṇāviṣṭābhyasyamānā sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvāya kalpate na tu ādyā
